claim.summary: Raw external finite-coordinate evidence, consisting of raw modulus-square residual evidence and raw strict real-part gap evidence, feeds the reusable coordinate checklist core and implies shifted squared-modulus dominance over every coordinate in the finite list.
claim.raw_residual_input: forall p in coords, |(p.1^2 + p.2^2) - (a^2 + b^2)| <= B
claim.raw_gap_input: forall p in coords, p.1 <= a - δ
claim.built_checklist: CoordinateEnvelopeChecklist c a b B δ coords
claim.dominance_result: forall p in coords, shiftedSqMod c p.1 p.2 < shiftedSqMod c a b

proves: raw modulus-square residual evidence builds ResidualEnvelope a b B coords
raw strict real-part gap evidence builds PositiveGapEnvelope a δ coords
raw external finite-coordinate evidence builds CoordinateEnvelopeChecklist c a b B δ coords
raw external finite-coordinate evidence feeds the imported finite coordinate dominance master theorem
finite-coordinate shifted dominance follows from raw residual evidence, raw strict-gap evidence, and scalar side conditions
does_not_prove: that any coordinate is an eigenvalue
that the coordinate list is a matrix spectrum
actual spectrum extraction from a matrix
construction of B from a matrix spectrum
construction of δ from a matrix spectral gap
strict spectral-abscissa hypothesis for a matrix eigenvalue
that a strict-abscissa eigenvalue of a real matrix is real
